## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

with a selection of more than 500 retailers and trusted local grocers across North America. Then,

When you get to the store, use the Instacart app to notify us. Depending on the store, a shopper or

### How much does Instacart cost?

clubs, like Costco, Sam’s Club, and BJ’s Wholesale Club, without a retailer club membership.

store deliveries, and deliveries under $35.

Pickup: There may be a “pickup fee” (equivalent to a delivery fee for pickup orders) on your pick up
order.

Service fees: Service fees vary and are subject to change based on factors like location and the
number and types of items in your cart. Orders containing alcohol have a separate service fee.

With an optional Instacart+ membership, you can get $0 delivery fees* on eligible orders (grocery
and retail $10+, Costco $35+ and restaurants $25+). *Service fees apply.

### Will I pay the same price on Instacart as I would in store?

Retail partners set the prices of items on the Instacart marketplace. While many retailers offer
everyday store prices on Instacart, some retailers may set prices on the Instacart platform that are
different from in-store prices.

You can view pricing policies for each retailer on the Instacart app and website.

### What happens if something is out of stock and I need to give specific instructions?

Instacart makes it easy to communicate with your shopper. When an item you want is out-of-stock at
the store, your shopper will follow your replacement preferences.

You can set item and delivery instructions in advance, as well as chat directly with your shopper
while they shop and deliver your items. You can tell the shopper to:
* Find Best Match: By default, your shopper will use their best judgement to pick a replacement for
  your item.
* Pick Specific Replacement: You can pick a specific alternative for the shopper to purchase if your
  first choice is out-of-stock.
* Don’t Replace: For items you’d rather not replace, choose “Don’t replace” to get a refund if the
  item is out of stock.
You can update or cancel your order as long as your shopper hasn’t started shopping. If you need to
make changes after shopping has started, you can use the app or website to approve replacements or
chat with your shopper.

### What happens if there's an issue with my order?

If something isn’t right, you’ve got options. In the Instacart app or website, you can report:
* Missing items
* Incorrect items
* Damaged items
* Poor replacements
* Early/late orders
If an order never came, or you get someone else’s order, you can reach out to Instacart Customer
Experience.

### Can I get contactless delivery with Instacart?

The health and safety of our community is our number one priority. We are excited to offer
contactless delivery through our Leave at My Door delivery feature.

Leave at My Door delivery gives you the flexibility to have your groceries delivered without having
to come to the door or be at home. You can leave delivery instructions for your shopper at checkout,
and we’ll notify you when your order arrives.

Leave at My Door is now the default setting for all Instacart deliveries. If you’d prefer to not use
this feature, simply uncheck the box that says “Leave at my door if I’m not around” at checkout.

Customers who order alcohol, prescriptions, or certain high-value items may need to show ID upon
delivery. We ask shoppers to wear masks whenever they come into contact with customers.

store employee will bring the groceries to your car, or you can pick them up at the designated area.

### How much does Instacart cost?

You don’t need a membership to order with Instacart. In fact, you can even order from warehouse
clubs, like Costco, Sam’s Club, and BJ’s Wholesale Club, without a retailer club membership.

To get started, create an account, select the store you want to shop, and place your order.

Delivery: Fees start at $3.99 for same-day orders over $35. Fees vary for one-hour deliveries, club
store deliveries, and deliveries under $35.

Pickup: There may be a “pickup fee” (equivalent to a delivery fee for pickup orders) on your pick up
order.

Service fees: Service fees vary and are subject to change based on factors like location and the
number and types of items in your cart. Orders containing alcohol have a separate service fee.

With an optional Instacart+ membership, you can get $0 delivery fees* on eligible orders (grocery
and retail $10+, Costco $35+ and restaurants $25+). *Service fees apply.

### Will I pay the same price on Instacart as I would in store?

Retail partners set the prices of items on the Instacart marketplace. While many retailers offer
everyday store prices on Instacart, some retailers may set prices on the Instacart platform that are
different from in-store prices.

You can view pricing policies for each retailer on the Instacart app and website.

### What happens if something is out of stock and I need to give specific instructions?

Instacart makes it easy to communicate with your shopper. When an item you want is out-of-stock at
the store, your shopper will follow your replacement preferences.

You can set item and delivery instructions in advance, as well as chat directly with your shopper
while they shop and deliver your items. You can tell the shopper to:
* Find Best Match: By default, your shopper will use their best judgement to pick a replacement for
  your item.
* Pick Specific Replacement: You can pick a specific alternative for the shopper to purchase if your
  first choice is out-of-stock.
* Don’t Replace: For items you’d rather not replace, choose “Don’t replace” to get a refund if the
  item is out of stock.
You can update or cancel your order as long as your shopper hasn’t started shopping. If you need to
make changes after shopping has started, you can use the app or website to approve replacements or
chat with your shopper.

### What happens if there's an issue with my order?

If something isn’t right, you’ve got options. In the Instacart app or website, you can report:
* Missing items
* Incorrect items
* Damaged items
* Poor replacements
* Early/late orders
If an order never came, or you get someone else’s order, you can reach out to Instacart Customer
Experience.

### Can I get contactless delivery with Instacart?

The health and safety of our community is our number one priority. We are excited to offer
contactless delivery through our Leave at My Door delivery feature.

Leave at My Door delivery gives you the flexibility to have your groceries delivered without having
to come to the door or be at home. You can leave delivery instructions for your shopper at checkout,
and we’ll notify you when your order arrives.

Leave at My Door is now the default setting for all Instacart deliveries. If you’d prefer to not use
this feature, simply uncheck the box that says “Leave at my door if I’m not around” at checkout.

Customers who order alcohol, prescriptions, or certain high-value items may need to show ID upon
delivery. We ask shoppers to wear masks whenever they come into contact with customers.

## A Trusted Leader
## In The Foodservice Industry

More than 100 years of experience and adaptation

We deliver success through a blend of proven expertise and willingness to embrace change. Yes, we
started delivering food in 1885, but we’ve never stopped moving or rested on our laurels. We are
always looking for fresh ideas, simple solutions and new ways to serve our customers, while using
the knowledge we’ve gained to streamline our operations and processes. That’s why our customers
count on us for safety and efficiency, but also to show them what’s coming next.




Jamie Guadagnino

## Developing Your Future

Jamie Guadagnino, Vice President of Sales, Vistar

Jamie Guadagnino began her journey with PFG over 20 years ago as a Customer Service Representative.
She advanced through a variety of positions over the years and through hard work and commitment, she
is now Vice President of Sales, Vistar.

I value the trust and investment that PFG places in my development. I still have much to learn in my
current role, and look forward to working here for many more years to come.

## Careers

Find the right job

PFG is a great place to start and build a career. We hire in a variety of fields.

** Drivers
** Warehouse
** Sales
** Finance
** Supply Chain
** Marketing
** Human Resources
** Information Technology
** Procurement

[Search For Jobs ][25]

### Delivering Success With A Focus On Innovation

We find flexible, efficient solutions for our customers


Everything we do is built around ensuring our customers’ businesses thrive. We started delivering
food in 1885 and over the years have re-invented ourselves time and again to stay ahead of the
industry. That’s why our customers don’t just see us as order takers; they see us as success
makers.

# Unilever Global

[Close ][66]

## Summary

A range of Unilever products being used, as well as advertising lifestyle imagery. Text throughout
the video reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3
steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at
Scale.”

## Detailed description

The video begins with a close-up of a woman with curly hair adorned with gold bows smiling directly
into the camera. Her hands move toward the lens, briefly obscuring the view as she frames her face.
She wears a soft, light-toned top and has bright blue nail polish, creating a vibrant contrast
against her skin. The text “Unilever is home” appears, suggesting the start of a message about the
company. The frame pans out to show the woman is wearing an off-shoulder dress and standing in a
grand, ornate room. Several other people are visible in the background in a masked ball setting in
an elaborate regency-style room.

The next frame shows a close-up of a revolving jar of Dove 10-in-1 Serum Mask Intensive Repair. The
jar is white with a gold-coloured lid, and the background is silvery grey. The overlaid text sitting
to the left of the product, which reads “to some of the world’s”, continues the message from the
previous screen.

The scene cuts to a refrigerator interior shot. A bottle of Hellmann’s Spicy Mayonnaise stands
upright in the centre, surrounded by fresh ingredients such as tomatoes and red peppers. Bold blue
text, which reads “most iconic”, overlays the image.

The frame then switches to a close-up of a hand lifting a white piece of fabric in iridescent pastel
lighting, with soft-focus people in the background. The person’s reflection is visible on the sheet.
The words “and beloved” are overlaid, and the Vaseline logo appears in the top corner.

Next, the camera transitions to a Persil Wonder Wash detergent bottle, angled dynamically with water
droplets against a clean, blue-toned background. The word “brands” appears on screen.

The video then cuts to an overhead shot of a jar of smooth white cream. A hand with red nail polish
uses a small spatula to scoop some of the cream. The words “We’re staying” appear over the product.

The next frame shows a close-up of smooth gel-like cream in soft peach tones, with the number “1”
overlaid. This is followed by an abstract close-up of liquid bubbles on a blue background, with the
number “2” overlaid. And then a close-up of fresh lime slices against a white background, with the
number “3” overlaid. Next, the video zooms in on hands holding a small gold box against a light
background, casting a soft shadow. The words “steps ahead” appear over the box.

A close-up shot of fine red powder dispersing across a white background appears, creating a
textured, granular effect. The word “Transforming” appears over the image.

This is followed by a close-up of orange powder dispersing against a dark green background, with the
word “into” overlaid.

A new frame comes into view featuring three women standing shoulder to shoulder, smiling confidently
at the camera. They are diverse in appearance: one with short, curly hair; one with long, dark curly
hair; and one with straight, light brown hair. One woman has a visible arm tattoo. Overlaid text
reads: “a Marketing & Sales machine”.

The next frame shows a woman in a black beret and black-and-white striped jacket, wearing a red
necklace, eating cherries in a warm, soft-focus interior. The words “With SASSY brands” appear
beside her.

A stylised split-screen scene appears. Two women pose in elegant, black outfits within circular
frames. Both are holding a perfume bottle. The word “creating” repeats across the screen. The brand
name Nexxus appears at the bottom.

The screen focuses in on a woman with long, glossy dark hair and red lipstick, wearing a red coat
against a dark background with falling droplets. The word “Desire” is overlaid prominently.

This is followed by a close-up of two Nexxus bottles positioned diagonally against a black
background, partially visible at opposite corners, with the word “at” centred between them.

The next frame shows a Vaseline Gluta-Hya lip serum tube in cherry colour, positioned among large,
glossy red spheres against a light background. The word “Scale” appears prominently on the left.

Finally, the video switches into a soft, gradient background blending pastel shades of blue, purple
and pink. At the centre sits the Unilever logo, with the words “Desire at Scale”.

Across all the frames, the wording in its entirety reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s
most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3 steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales
machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at Scale.”

No audio and no captions available

Business Groups

## The world’s best-known brands creating Desire at Scale

Our brands touch billions of lives every day.

[A woman smiles as she rubs cream into her bare shoulder.]

### [Beauty & Wellbeing][67]

No more trade-offs. No more compromises. Just beauty and wellbeing as one.

[A man dressed for the gym confidently applies deodorant to his underarm.]

### [Personal Care][68]

Powering up Personal Care, developing superior products with breakthrough science and technology.

[A woman pulls her cosy sweater up over her face to below her glinting eyes.]

### [Home Care][69]

Delivering joyful cleaning experiences for people everywhere.

[Person holding a crispy chicken sandwich with lettuce and pickles.]

### [Foods][70]

For the love of food – great taste is at the heart of everything we do.

[A close-up display of various hair and skincare products arranged on a reflective surface,
including Dove Bond Strength conditioner, TRESemmé Silk Press serum, TRESemmé Lamellar Gloss
finishing oil, and other branded items in the background.]

Unilever LinkedIn

## On social media

Latest conversations, announcements and insights.

[Elfried Samba wears a wide-brimmed hat standing in front of a large FIFA World Cup 2026™ football
pop up.]

### [Elfried Samba goes inside our FIFA World Cup 2026™ activation (Opens in new modal)][71]

[Close ][72]

(1 of 10)

## Elfried Samba goes inside our FIFA World Cup 2026™ activation

JavaScript must be enabled to view this content

We invited Elfried Samba, a leading voice on creators and community, to join us behind the scenes at
the FIFA World Cup 2026™, where Unilever is the Official Personal Care Sponsor.

His verdict? Our biggest-ever sports activation puts creators at its centre, giving them experiences
that are too good not to post – a move that sparks authentic content and makes a global event feel
personal. Because scale is great. But scale without relevance is just expensive noise.

Watch the first video in Elf’s three-part series here, and there’s more to come.

[Previous itemUnilever unveils plans for $270 million US-based global innovation centre][73][Next
itemElfried Samba on House of Fresh, our FIFA World Cup 2026™ creator hub][74]
[The Rexona team stand behind a counter in the New York House of Fresh™.]

### [Elfried Samba on House of Fresh, our FIFA World Cup 2026™ creator hub (Opens in new modal)][75]

[Close ][76]

(2 of 10)

## Elfried Samba on House of Fresh, our FIFA World Cup 2026™ creator hub

JavaScript must be enabled to view this content

“When creators want to film, wear, share and talk about your products you’re not just buying reach.
You’re increasing the chances of relevance, product desire and conversion.”

That’s what a leading voice on creators and community, Elfried Samba said after joining us at
Unilever Personal Care’s House of Fresh – our immersive creator hub at the FIFA World Cup 2026™.

## Summary

A range of Unilever products being used, as well as advertising lifestyle imagery. Text throughout
the video reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3
steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at
Scale.”

## Detailed description

The video begins with a close-up of a woman with curly hair adorned with gold bows smiling directly
into the camera. Her hands move toward the lens, briefly obscuring the view as she frames her face.
She wears a soft, light-toned top and has bright blue nail polish, creating a vibrant contrast
against her skin. The text “Unilever is home” appears, suggesting the start of a message about the
company. The frame pans out to show the woman is wearing an off-shoulder dress and standing in a
grand, ornate room. Several other people are visible in the background in a masked ball setting in
an elaborate regency-style room.

The next frame shows a close-up of a revolving jar of Dove 10-in-1 Serum Mask Intensive Repair. The
jar is white with a gold-coloured lid, and the background is silvery grey. The overlaid text sitting
to the left of the product, which reads “to some of the world’s”, continues the message from the
previous screen.

The scene cuts to a refrigerator interior shot. A bottle of Hellmann’s Spicy Mayonnaise stands
upright in the centre, surrounded by fresh ingredients such as tomatoes and red peppers. Bold blue
text, which reads “most iconic”, overlays the image.

The frame then switches to a close-up of a hand lifting a white piece of fabric in iridescent pastel
lighting, with soft-focus people in the background. The person’s reflection is visible on the sheet.
The words “and beloved” are overlaid, and the Vaseline logo appears in the top corner.

Next, the camera transitions to a Persil Wonder Wash detergent bottle, angled dynamically with water
droplets against a clean, blue-toned background. The word “brands” appears on screen.

The video then cuts to an overhead shot of a jar of smooth white cream. A hand with red nail polish
uses a small spatula to scoop some of the cream. The words “We’re staying” appear over the product.

The next frame shows a close-up of smooth gel-like cream in soft peach tones, with the number “1”
overlaid. This is followed by an abstract close-up of liquid bubbles on a blue background, with the
number “2” overlaid. And then a close-up of fresh lime slices against a white background, with the
number “3” overlaid. Next, the video zooms in on hands holding a small gold box against a light
background, casting a soft shadow. The words “steps ahead” appear over the box.

A close-up shot of fine red powder dispersing across a white background appears, creating a
textured, granular effect. The word “Transforming” appears over the image.

This is followed by a close-up of orange powder dispersing against a dark green background, with the
word “into” overlaid.

A new frame comes into view featuring three women standing shoulder to shoulder, smiling confidently
at the camera. They are diverse in appearance: one with short, curly hair; one with long, dark curly
hair; and one with straight, light brown hair. One woman has a visible arm tattoo. Overlaid text
reads: “a Marketing & Sales machine”.

The next frame shows a woman in a black beret and black-and-white striped jacket, wearing a red
necklace, eating cherries in a warm, soft-focus interior. The words “With SASSY brands” appear
beside her.

A stylised split-screen scene appears. Two women pose in elegant, black outfits within circular
frames. Both are holding a perfume bottle. The word “creating” repeats across the screen. The brand
name Nexxus appears at the bottom.

The screen focuses in on a woman with long, glossy dark hair and red lipstick, wearing a red coat
against a dark background with falling droplets. The word “Desire” is overlaid prominently.

This is followed by a close-up of two Nexxus bottles positioned diagonally against a black
background, partially visible at opposite corners, with the word “at” centred between them.

The next frame shows a Vaseline Gluta-Hya lip serum tube in cherry colour, positioned among large,
glossy red spheres against a light background. The word “Scale” appears prominently on the left.

Finally, the video switches into a soft, gradient background blending pastel shades of blue, purple
and pink. At the centre sits the Unilever logo, with the words “Desire at Scale”.

Across all the frames, the wording in its entirety reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s
most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3 steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales
machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at Scale.”

نسخه آزمایشی
" بهشـــــــــهر "

فعالیت های بازرگانی گروه صنایع بهشهر در سال ۱۳۲۳ با تاسیس شرکت سهامی بازرگانی آرین ( سهامی خاص)
نخستین شرکت بازرگانی وابسته به هلدینگ آغاز گردید و سپس در سال ۱۳۳۰ فعالیت‌های تولیدی خود را شروع
نمود.
این شرکت در ۱۴ دی ماه سال ۱۳۴۹ با نام "شرکت سهامی خاص توسعه صنایع آرین" در اداره ثبت شرکت‌ها و مالکیت
صنعتی تهران به ثبت رسید. این شرکت به عنوان یک هلدینگ صنایع غذایی و شوینده، با سرمایه اولیه ۲۵۰
میلیون ریال آغاز بکار کرد. در ۲۰ مرداد ماه سال ۱۳۵۰ براساس تصمیم مجمع عمومی فوق العاده ابتدا به "
شرکت توسعه صنایع بهشهر" تغییر نام داد و سپس در سال ۱۳۵۳ بهشهر از سهامی خاص به سهامی عام تبدیل شد و
با نام تجاری "وبشهر" در سازمان بورس و اوراق بهادار شروع به فعالیت کرد.

" بهشـــــــــهر "

فعالیت های بازرگانی گروه صنایع بهشهر در سال ۱۳۲۳ با تاسیس شرکت سهامی بازرگانی آرین ( سهامی خاص)
نخستین شرکت بازرگانی وابسته به هلدینگ آغاز گردید و سپس در سال ۱۳۳۰ فعالیت‌های تولیدی خود را شروع
نمود.
این شرکت در ۱۴ دی ماه سال ۱۳۴۹ با نام "شرکت سهامی خاص توسعه صنایع آرین" در اداره ثبت شرکت‌ها و مالکیت
صنعتی تهران به ثبت رسید. این شرکت به عنوان یک هلدینگ صنایع غذایی و شوینده، با سرمایه اولیه ۲۵۰
میلیون ریال آغاز بکار کرد. در ۲۰ مرداد ماه سال ۱۳۵۰ براساس تصمیم مجمع عمومی فوق العاده ابتدا به "
شرکت توسعه صنایع بهشهر" تغییر نام داد و سپس در سال ۱۳۵۳ بهشهر از سهامی خاص به سهامی عام تبدیل شد و
با نام تجاری "وبشهر" در سازمان بورس و اوراق بهادار شروع به فعالیت کرد.

At Butterball® Farms, we believe flavor is more than taste. It’s an experience that connects us
through shared meals, memorable moments, and crave-worthy bites. With over 70 years as a bulk butter
supplier, we’ve crafted premium butter and flavored butter solutions that add richness, personality,
and lasting value to every culinary occasion.

From our portion-controlled single-serve [butter shapes][62] and [Quik-Creations® Butter Sauce][63],
ready to order from your local distributor, to custom flavored butters and sauces, our creations are
designed to simplify prep, enhance presentation, and keep customers coming back for more. Whether
you’re shaping menus or building a brand, we’re your creative partner in crafting flavor experiences
that truly stand out.

### Chef Darrin Mayweather

“Butterball Farms Quik-Creations Premium Butter Sauce is incredibly versatile and flavorful. I’ve
used it for sautéing, searing, browning, and even baking, and it performs exceptionally well across
all applications. It’s ideal for creating butter-based sauces like bearnaise and wine reduction, and
it’s perfect for infusing flavors such as lemon, garlic, and rosemary. I believe any chef would love
its durability across multiple menu applications.”

### Labor Savings

After running the numbers, one large-scale wholesale corporation discovered that partnering with
Butterball® Farms generated $200k in labor savings compared to producing their product in-house. 

### Cravability

One popular American fast-food chain has used our flavored butter on a signature item for years.
Even after all this time, their customers have demanded that the item stay on the menu. 

### Profits

By adding our flavor solution to their burgers, another popular American fast-food chain was able to
increase their profit by $0.90/burger.

### Versatile

A top-rated brand used our butter sauce base as their speed scratch base to create five different
sauces for their entrees.

### Reliable

One popular American fast-food chain has trusted Butterball® Farms to supply a key ingredient for
one of their signature items since 1972.

## A Legacy Built on Butter, Not Birds

We’re not the turkey company, but [our story ][81]does start there. Our founder, Leo Peters, made
sure to retain the rights to the Butterball name when he sold the turkey patents in the 1960s, eager
to translate his innovative mind and high-quality food production experience into the realm of
butter and custom flavors. 

That mindset continues today with second-generation owner Mark Peters, who has a trendsetting
passion for flavor, innovation, and imagination of the culinary arts to produce products that
greatly enhance your brand.

### Chef Darrin Mayweather

“Butterball Farms Quik-Creations Premium Butter Sauce is incredibly versatile and flavorful. I’ve
used it for sautéing, searing, browning, and even baking, and it performs exceptionally well across
all applications. It’s ideal for creating butter-based sauces like bearnaise and wine reduction, and
it’s perfect for infusing flavors such as lemon, garlic, and rosemary. I believe any chef would love
its durability across multiple menu applications.”

### Labor Savings

After running the numbers, one large-scale wholesale corporation discovered that partnering with
Butterball® Farms generated $200k in labor savings compared to producing their product in-house. 

### Cravability

One popular American fast-food chain has used our flavored butter on a signature item for years.
Even after all this time, their customers have demanded that the item stay on the menu. 

### Profits

By adding our flavor solution to their burgers, another popular American fast-food chain was able to
increase their profit by $0.90/burger.

A top-rated brand used our butter sauce base as their speed scratch base to create five different
sauces for their entrees.

One popular American fast-food chain has trusted Butterball® Farms to supply a key ingredient for
one of their signature items since 1972.

butter and custom flavors. 

That mindset continues today with second-generation owner Mark Peters, who has a trendsetting
passion for flavor, innovation, and imagination of the culinary arts to produce products that

# Adapt fast, produce smart

## Om Dragsbæk

Dragsbæk er en dansk fødevareproducent med ekspertise i funktionelle fedtstoffer og drikkevarer.

Vi rykker hurtigt, tilpasser os markedet og sætter en ære i at levere de bedst mulige løsninger til
vores partnere i industri, bageri, foodservice og detail.

[ Læs mere om Dragsbæk ][52]

+2 mia

### Ansatte

500

### Markeder

40 

### Functional fats

100,000 tons

### Beverage & nutrition

100,000 tons

## Functional fats

Funktionelle fedtstoffer der løfter bagning og madlavning fra godt til bedre. Vores sortiment
omfatter smør, smørblandinger, margariner, smørbare løsninger, vegetabilske olier og specialfedt.
Fås som clean label, palmeoliefri, økologisk, plantebaseret, hybrid samt fuldt mejeribaserede
løsninger. Designet til professionelle bagerier, køkkener og industriel fødevareproduktion, hvor
ydeevne og funktionalitet er afgørende.

[ Læs mere ][53]

## Beverage & Nutrition

Vores sortiment dækker plantebaserede og mejeribaserede drikke, barista‑produkter, sportsdrikke,
smagssatte drikke samt madlavningsfløder. Alle produkter er UHT‑behandlede og udviklet til lang
holdbarhed, stabil performance og nem anvendelse på tværs af detail, foodservice og industrielle
applikationer. 

[ Læs mere ][54]

## Ice Cream & Desserts

Vi sætter baren for is og desserter på det Nordiske marked. Vi tilbyder plantebaseret, mejeribaseret
og økologisk is samt mousser og desserter i en lang række formater. Fra vafler, ispinde og bægre til
bakker og is-kantiner – fyldt med smage og inclusions som cookie dough, lakrids og funky jams.

# Adapt fast, produce smart

## Om Dragsbæk

Dragsbæk er en dansk fødevareproducent med ekspertise i funktionelle fedtstoffer og drikkevarer.

Vi rykker hurtigt, tilpasser os markedet og sætter en ære i at levere de bedst mulige løsninger til
vores partnere i industri, bageri, foodservice og detail.

[ Læs mere om Dragsbæk ][52]

## Dragsbæk i tal

### Årlig omsætning i alt

+2 mia

### Ansatte

500

### Markeder

40 

### Functional fats

100,000 tons

### Beverage & nutrition

100,000 tons

## Functional fats

Funktionelle fedtstoffer der løfter bagning og madlavning fra godt til bedre. Vores sortiment
omfatter smør, smørblandinger, margariner, smørbare løsninger, vegetabilske olier og specialfedt.
Fås som clean label, palmeoliefri, økologisk, plantebaseret, hybrid samt fuldt mejeribaserede
løsninger. Designet til professionelle bagerier, køkkener og industriel fødevareproduktion, hvor
ydeevne og funktionalitet er afgørende.

[ Læs mere ][53]

## Beverage & Nutrition

Vores sortiment dækker plantebaserede og mejeribaserede drikke, barista‑produkter, sportsdrikke,
smagssatte drikke samt madlavningsfløder. Alle produkter er UHT‑behandlede og udviklet til lang
holdbarhed, stabil performance og nem anvendelse på tværs af detail, foodservice og industrielle
applikationer. 

[ Læs mere ][54]

## Ice Cream & Desserts

Vi sætter baren for is og desserter på det Nordiske marked. Vi tilbyder plantebaseret, mejeribaseret
og økologisk is samt mousser og desserter i en lang række formater. Fra vafler, ispinde og bægre til
bakker og is-kantiner – fyldt med smage og inclusions som cookie dough, lakrids og funky jams.

[ Læs mere ][55]

## **Industry Solutions **

[[FRUIT&VEGETABLE PRODUCTION LINE][FRUIT&VEGETABLE PRODUCTION LINE]][158]
[FRUIT&VEGETABLE PROCESSING LINE][159]

### Complete processing solutions for fresh fruits and vegetables, covering washing, sorting,
### crushing, pulping, juice extracting, separating, enzymatic treatment, concentration and
### sterilization.

### Suitable for producing juice, puree, concentrate, fruit & vegetable sauces, jams, fermented
### products, with stable quality and scalable capacity for industrial production.

[[Milk and dairy processing line ][Milk and dairy processing line ]][160]
[MILK&DAIRY PROCESSING LINE ][161]

### Turn-key dairy processing lines for liquid milk and value-added dairy products.

### Designed for pasteurized milk, UHT milk, flavored milk drinks, milk powder, condensed milk,
### yogurt, cheese and butter, integrating raw milk reception, standardization, fermentation, 
### homogenization, heat treatment, concentration, spray drying and hygienic filling.

[[PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ][PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ]][162]
[PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ][163]

### Integrated plant-based milk processing solutions for nuts, grains and legumes.

### Suitable for coconut, almond, walnut, cashew, oats, beans, peas, peanut, sesame and other raw
### materials, enabling efficient soaking, grinding, enzymatic treatment, filtration, homogenization
### and sterilization to produce stable, high-protein plant-based beverages.

[[Sauce and dresssing processing lines ][Sauce and dresssing processing lines ]][164]
[SAUCE&DRESSINGS PROCESSING LINE ][165]

### Customized sauce and dressing production lines for high-viscosity and multi-phase products.

### Capable of processing tomato sauce, mayonnaise, chili sauce, onion garlic sauce, salad dressings
### and compound sauces, ensuring uniform texture, stable emulsion and consistent flavor.

[[beverage processing line ][beverage processing line ]][166]
[BEVERAGE PROCESSING LINE][167]

### Turn-key beverage processing lines for non-carbonated and carbonated drinks.

### Suitable for tea and coffee based drinks, juice beverages, milk-based drinks, functional
### beverages and carbonated drinks, integrating beverage preparation and blending, filtration, heat
### treatment, CIP and hygienic filling.

[[DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE][DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE]][168]
[DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE][169]

### Dry food and powder processing solutions for liquid-to-powder conversion.

### Applied to milk powder, plant-based milk powder, bone broth powder,  fruit & vegetable powder
### and egg powder  utilizing evaporation, drying and powder handling systems for stable quality and
### long shelf life.


## **Core Processing Equipment**

[[SUS304 tanks][SUS304 tanks]][170]
[Stainless Steel Tanks][171]

### Customized stainless steel tanks (SUS304 / SUS316L) for hygienic liquid food and beverage
### processing.

### Designed for materials storage, dissolving, heating, cooling, mixing, dispersion,
### emulsification, fermentation, enzymatic reaction and juice extraction, with sanitary design and
### flexible configuration.


[[Pulping machine][Pulping machine]][172]
[CRUSHING&PULPING SYSTEM][173]

### Industrial crushing and pulping systems for fruits and vegetables.

### Functions include crushing, seed removal, peeling, pitting and pulping, forming the core
### processing unit for fruit and vegetable puree and juice production lines.


[[belt filter press][belt filter press]][174]
[JUICE EXTRACTOR SYSTEM][175]

### Multi-type juice extraction systems for different raw materials and capacities.

### Including citrus extractors, spiral extractors, belt presses and roller presses, suitable for a
### wide range of fruits and vegetables with optimized juice yield and quality.


[[Fruit juice evaporator][Fruit juice evaporator]][176]
[EVAPORATOR&DRYER SYSTEM][177]

### Evaporation and drying systems for concentration and powder production.

### Including falling film and forced circulation evaporators, centrifuge dryers and pressure
### dryers, widely used in juice and milk concentration, fruit & vegetable powder and milk powder
### processing.


[[UHT Sterilizer][UHT Sterilizer]][178]
[STERILIZER SYSTEM][179]

### Thermal sterilization/pasteurization systems for liquid food and beverage processing.

### Applied before or after filling, providing UHT, HTST and customized heat treatment solutions,
### suitable for different products, viscosities and packaging requirements.


[[Aseptic bags filler][Aseptic bags filler]][180]
[FILLING SYSTEM ][181]

### Flexible filling systems for liquid food and beverage products.

### Suitable for aseptic bags, bottles, cans, pouches and cartons, with filling solutions tailored
### to product characteristics, container types and hygiene standards.

## **Our Advantage **

## Solid Engineering Ability

### With over 20 years of engineering experience in fruit, dairy and beverage processing, we have
### successfully delivered 500+ industrial projects worldwide.

### Our experienced engineering team is capable of solving complex process integration and on-site
### technical challenges, ensuring stable and reliable project execution.

## Advanced Processing Technology

### Our processing equipment is designed using 3D engineering software and manufactured with
### high-precision laser cutting, CNC machining, welding and fabrication technologies.

### Critical components are processed with strict dimensional and quality control to ensure stable
### performance, high accuracy and reliability.

## R&D Investment

### We continuously invest in R&D and process optimization to meet evolving food and beverage
### industry requirements.

### Supported by academic collaboration and in-house engineering development, we have obtained 120+
### technical patents, enabling customized and future-proof solutions.

## Extensive International Cooperation

## **Industry Solutions **

[[FRUIT&VEGETABLE PRODUCTION LINE][FRUIT&VEGETABLE PRODUCTION LINE]][158]
[FRUIT&VEGETABLE PROCESSING LINE][159]

### Complete processing solutions for fresh fruits and vegetables, covering washing, sorting,
### crushing, pulping, juice extracting, separating, enzymatic treatment, concentration and
### sterilization.

### Suitable for producing juice, puree, concentrate, fruit & vegetable sauces, jams, fermented
### products, with stable quality and scalable capacity for industrial production.

[[Milk and dairy processing line ][Milk and dairy processing line ]][160]
[MILK&DAIRY PROCESSING LINE ][161]

### Turn-key dairy processing lines for liquid milk and value-added dairy products.

### Designed for pasteurized milk, UHT milk, flavored milk drinks, milk powder, condensed milk,
### yogurt, cheese and butter, integrating raw milk reception, standardization, fermentation, 
### homogenization, heat treatment, concentration, spray drying and hygienic filling.

[[PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ][PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ]][162]
[PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ][163]

### Integrated plant-based milk processing solutions for nuts, grains and legumes.

### Suitable for coconut, almond, walnut, cashew, oats, beans, peas, peanut, sesame and other raw
### materials, enabling efficient soaking, grinding, enzymatic treatment, filtration, homogenization
### and sterilization to produce stable, high-protein plant-based beverages.

[[Sauce and dresssing processing lines ][Sauce and dresssing processing lines ]][164]
[SAUCE&DRESSINGS PROCESSING LINE ][165]

### Customized sauce and dressing production lines for high-viscosity and multi-phase products.

### Capable of processing tomato sauce, mayonnaise, chili sauce, onion garlic sauce, salad dressings
### and compound sauces, ensuring uniform texture, stable emulsion and consistent flavor.

[[beverage processing line ][beverage processing line ]][166]
[BEVERAGE PROCESSING LINE][167]

### Turn-key beverage processing lines for non-carbonated and carbonated drinks.

### Suitable for tea and coffee based drinks, juice beverages, milk-based drinks, functional
### beverages and carbonated drinks, integrating beverage preparation and blending, filtration, heat
### treatment, CIP and hygienic filling.

[[DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE][DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE]][168]
[DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE][169]

### Dry food and powder processing solutions for liquid-to-powder conversion.

### Applied to milk powder, plant-based milk powder, bone broth powder,  fruit & vegetable powder
### and egg powder  utilizing evaporation, drying and powder handling systems for stable quality and
### long shelf life.


## **Core Processing Equipment**

[[SUS304 tanks][SUS304 tanks]][170]
[Stainless Steel Tanks][171]

### Customized stainless steel tanks (SUS304 / SUS316L) for hygienic liquid food and beverage
### processing.

### Designed for materials storage, dissolving, heating, cooling, mixing, dispersion,
### emulsification, fermentation, enzymatic reaction and juice extraction, with sanitary design and
### flexible configuration.


[[Pulping machine][Pulping machine]][172]
[CRUSHING&PULPING SYSTEM][173]

### Industrial crushing and pulping systems for fruits and vegetables.

### Functions include crushing, seed removal, peeling, pitting and pulping, forming the core
### processing unit for fruit and vegetable puree and juice production lines.


[[belt filter press][belt filter press]][174]
[JUICE EXTRACTOR SYSTEM][175]

### Multi-type juice extraction systems for different raw materials and capacities.

### Including citrus extractors, spiral extractors, belt presses and roller presses, suitable for a
### wide range of fruits and vegetables with optimized juice yield and quality.


[[Fruit juice evaporator][Fruit juice evaporator]][176]
[EVAPORATOR&DRYER SYSTEM][177]

### Evaporation and drying systems for concentration and powder production.

### Including falling film and forced circulation evaporators, centrifuge dryers and pressure
### dryers, widely used in juice and milk concentration, fruit & vegetable powder and milk powder
### processing.


[[UHT Sterilizer][UHT Sterilizer]][178]
[STERILIZER SYSTEM][179]

### Thermal sterilization/pasteurization systems for liquid food and beverage processing.

### Applied before or after filling, providing UHT, HTST and customized heat treatment solutions,
### suitable for different products, viscosities and packaging requirements.


[[Aseptic bags filler][Aseptic bags filler]][180]
[FILLING SYSTEM ][181]

### Flexible filling systems for liquid food and beverage products.

### Suitable for aseptic bags, bottles, cans, pouches and cartons, with filling solutions tailored
### to product characteristics, container types and hygiene standards.

# EXPERTS IN MARGARINES

AND MUCH MORE!

### MISSION, VISION AND VALUES

###### THE BASIS OF OUR COMPANY

 

Our Mission, Vision and Values govern our daily activities, harness our international vocation as a
leader and guide us towards ethical behaviour to create value sustainably. For us, leaders should be
committed to the principles of ethics, safety, quality and, of course,… the Environment.

Of course, all these principles govern the ABCs of our code of values where honesty, enthusiasm,
improvement and teamwork are indispensable to achieving these key principles.

 

##### [DISCOVER MORE][49]

Gracomsa Alimentaria, as the flagship of the Nuova Secac Group’s food division, was launched in 1982
as a company dedicated to producing margarines, oils and speciality fats for the food industry. Over
these three decades of activity we have extended our lines of business towards other sectors with
the addition of new products in our catalogue.

 

Based in Valencia, it is the only 100% Spanish company that operates in the market of fats for the
food industry, facing off against large multi-brand multinational companies with own their brands.
It also develops customised products that conform to specific product requirements, conditions, and
objectives that have been requested.

### SUSTAINABILITY

At Gracomsa we have committed ourselves to promoting and contributing to sustainable development in
the company and all the sectors that are important to us. Said commitments are featured in the
Sustainability Plan which, in turn, is included in the Company’s Strategy Plan, with policies that
have been developed from an approach that includes environmental and economical aspects, fair
payments for our workers and collaborators to create an ethical economy that generates, and does not
detract, value.

 

##### [DISCOVER MORE][50]

Currently, Gracomsa has facilities with a production capacity of more than 60,000 tons of
margarines, oils and speciality fats per year. We sell to all sectors, from the food industry, to
the Horeca, Bakery and Retail industries, with a new production centre (Doccas Food), a cutting-edge
plant that is within the so-called industry 4.0. Doccas Food represents a new generation of
production leaders in Europe that embraces the smart factory concept which enables the highest
standards of quality and food control to be reached.

# EXPERTS IN MARGARINES

AND MUCH MORE!

### MISSION, VISION AND VALUES

###### THE BASIS OF OUR COMPANY

 

Our Mission, Vision and Values govern our daily activities, harness our international vocation as a
leader and guide us towards ethical behaviour to create value sustainably. For us, leaders should be
committed to the principles of ethics, safety, quality and, of course,… the Environment.

Of course, all these principles govern the ABCs of our code of values where honesty, enthusiasm,
improvement and teamwork are indispensable to achieving these key principles.

 

##### [DISCOVER MORE][49]

Gracomsa Alimentaria, as the flagship of the Nuova Secac Group’s food division, was launched in 1982
as a company dedicated to producing margarines, oils and speciality fats for the food industry. Over
these three decades of activity we have extended our lines of business towards other sectors with
the addition of new products in our catalogue.

 

Based in Valencia, it is the only 100% Spanish company that operates in the market of fats for the
food industry, facing off against large multi-brand multinational companies with own their brands.
It also develops customised products that conform to specific product requirements, conditions, and
objectives that have been requested.

### SUSTAINABILITY

At Gracomsa we have committed ourselves to promoting and contributing to sustainable development in
the company and all the sectors that are important to us. Said commitments are featured in the
Sustainability Plan which, in turn, is included in the Company’s Strategy Plan, with policies that
have been developed from an approach that includes environmental and economical aspects, fair
payments for our workers and collaborators to create an ethical economy that generates, and does not
detract, value.

 

##### [DISCOVER MORE][50]

Currently, Gracomsa has facilities with a production capacity of more than 60,000 tons of
margarines, oils and speciality fats per year. We sell to all sectors, from the food industry, to
the Horeca, Bakery and Retail industries, with a new production centre (Doccas Food), a cutting-edge
plant that is within the so-called industry 4.0. Doccas Food represents a new generation of
production leaders in Europe that embraces the smart factory concept which enables the highest
standards of quality and food control to be reached.

By creating a unique collection of innovative ingredients for GRANDPRO baking, RUSAGRO Group experts
focused on the current needs of confectionery artists working in the HoReCa field or developing
their own business.

Impeccable quality, technological efficiency, economic efficiency, new ideas for pastry chefs and
your creative freedom are the fundamental values on which the GRANDPRO brand concept is based.

GRANDPRO is not only modern Russian—made products, but also a unique professional development
program that includes expert technological assistance to pastry chefs, educational projects, and the
exchange of experience and ideas. GRANDPRO helps you achieve success and improve in your favorite
profession!

## GRANDPRO MARGARINES

**GRANDPRO premium margarines** are an innovative line of high-tech plant-based ingredients for
pastry manufactures, restaurants, coffee shops, bakeries.

We make GRANDPRO margarines from high-quality natural raw materials, with no animal fats and
preservatives. GRANDPRO margarines are suitable for creating dairy-free desserts, lean baked
goodies, healthy lifestyle diets, as well as a wide range of classic bakery and pastries.

Working with GRAND PRO margarines, you are always confident in the stable quality of your products,
their long shelf life and aesthetic appearance.

To meet customer needs and help you to cook always great, we have created five special margarines
for various technological applications: **GRANDPRO Cake, GRANDPRO Tart, GRANDPRO Cream, GRANDPRO
Croissant** and ** GRANDPRO Eclair** covering a full range of pastry recipes.

**GRANDPRO Butter for professionals — ** butter for those who create and prefer traditions, or for
those who reinvent baking in a new way. We support you in your quest for perfection. **GRANDPRO
Butter ** has many advantages that make it indispensable for puff pastry and rich pastries,
shortcrust pastry, creams. The butter is ideal for all types of sauces, emulsions and other types of
culinary products. It is available in 5 kg blocks, a practical size for your production. Price: on
request

## GRANDPRO whipping paste

**GRANDPRO paste** is a complex food additive with a high concentration of working substances. It
contains emulsifiers of natural origin that are safe for human health. When preparing various types
of dough and creams, **GRANDPRO paste** increases aeration and stability of whipped masses.

**GRANDPRO paste** is a multifunctional ingredient and has proven itself well in various

custard and fruit and berry creams; semi-finished products for freezing. The paste is economical to
use.

It is available in 2 kg plastic buckets.

The cost starts from 300 rubles/kg excluding delivery.

## CONCEPT

By creating a unique collection of innovative ingredients for GRANDPRO baking, RUSAGRO Group experts
focused on the current needs of confectionery artists working in the HoReCa field or developing
their own business.

Impeccable quality, technological efficiency, economic efficiency, new ideas for pastry chefs and
your creative freedom are the fundamental values on which the GRANDPRO brand concept is based.

GRANDPRO is not only modern Russian—made products, but also a unique professional development
program that includes expert technological assistance to pastry chefs, educational projects, and the
exchange of experience and ideas. GRANDPRO helps you achieve success and improve in your favorite
profession!

## GRANDPRO MARGARINES

**GRANDPRO premium margarines** are an innovative line of high-tech plant-based ingredients for
pastry manufactures, restaurants, coffee shops, bakeries.

We make GRANDPRO margarines from high-quality natural raw materials, with no animal fats and
preservatives. GRANDPRO margarines are suitable for creating dairy-free desserts, lean baked
goodies, healthy lifestyle diets, as well as a wide range of classic bakery and pastries.

Working with GRAND PRO margarines, you are always confident in the stable quality of your products,
their long shelf life and aesthetic appearance.

To meet customer needs and help you to cook always great, we have created five special margarines
for various technological applications: **GRANDPRO Cake, GRANDPRO Tart, GRANDPRO Cream, GRANDPRO
Croissant** and ** GRANDPRO Eclair** covering a full range of pastry recipes.

CAKE

For cakes, Easter bread, rolls, pies, and muffins

[подробнее »][41]
ECLAIR

For creams and fillings of cakes, pastries, souffles

[подробнее »][42]

[CATALOG »][44]

## GRANDPRO BUTTER

**GRANDPRO Butter for professionals — ** butter for those who create and prefer traditions, or for
those who reinvent baking in a new way. We support you in your quest for perfection. **GRANDPRO
Butter ** has many advantages that make it indispensable for puff pastry and rich pastries,
shortcrust pastry, creams. The butter is ideal for all types of sauces, emulsions and other types of
culinary products. It is available in 5 kg blocks, a practical size for your production. Price: on
request

## GRANDPRO whipping paste

**GRANDPRO paste** is a complex food additive with a high concentration of working substances. It
contains emulsifiers of natural origin that are safe for human health. When preparing various types
of dough and creams, **GRANDPRO paste** increases aeration and stability of whipped masses.

**GRANDPRO paste** is a multifunctional ingredient and has proven itself well in various
applications, including the manufacture of biscuits, muffins, muffins and cakes; sweet biscuits;
custard and fruit and berry creams; semi-finished products for freezing. The paste is economical to
use.

It is available in 2 kg plastic buckets.

The cost starts from 300 rubles/kg excluding delivery.

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

#### Data Validation

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
refined to help guarantee superior, accurate results for our clients.

Read More

fruit. It’s a guilt-free, tantalizing treat that will have you savoring every drop while knowing

## [More Industrial Mixer Manufacturers][116]


### Industrial Mixer Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare industrial mixer manufacturers, mixer manufacturers, and specialized mixing
equipment suppliers serving chemical processing, food production, pharmaceuticals, water treatment,
coatings, adhesives, agriculture, and other demanding industries. This directory helps buyers browse
industrial mixers, mixers and agitators, batch systems, and related processing equipment by
application, material characteristics, and production goals. Whether you need to source an
industrial mixer for liquids, powders, slurries, or viscous compounds, this page is built to connect
engineers, purchasing teams, and plant managers with qualified suppliers that can match throughput,
consistency, sanitation, and process requirements across a wide range of manufacturing environments.

### Industrial Mixer Types and Core Functions

Industrial mixers support blending, dispersion, emulsification, and homogenization across many
production settings, making them a core category for buyers comparing equipment by viscosity, batch
size, and material behavior. Suppliers in this directory cover paddle, ribbon, planetary, static,
inline, and high shear designs used in chemical manufacturing, food processing, cosmetics, and
pharmaceutical production where repeatable mixing and controlled product quality matter.

### Industrial Agitators and Process Support Systems

Industrial agitators are often selected for lower-viscosity materials, tank circulation, suspension,
and process support in water treatment, storage, coating preparation, and liquid chemical handling.
Buyers searching industrial agitators, agitator manufacturer options, or complete mixers and
agitators can use this directory to compare suppliers that build equipment for maintaining
uniformity, supporting transfer operations, and improving consistency in continuous or
semi-continuous systems.

### Mixers and Agitators for Combined Process Needs

Industrial mixers and agitators are also specified together when facilities need broader process
flexibility across multiple products or stages of production. Buyers evaluating agitators and
mixers, agitators mixers, or mixer company capabilities often need suppliers that understand both
shear requirements and gentle blending, especially in operations involving adhesives, sealants,
pulp, slurry compounds, specialty chemicals, and prepared food ingredients.

### Industrial Batch Mixing Systems

Industrial batch mixers are especially relevant where formulations require timed cycles, ingredient
staging, recipe control, and lot traceability. These systems are common in pharmaceuticals,
nutraceuticals, dry blending, specialty coatings, and compound manufacturing, where plants need
precise repeatability and reliable discharge performance while balancing throughput with product
integrity.

### Industry Applications for Mixing Equipment

Food producers rely on industrial mixers for blending powders, liquids, syrups, and emulsions while
meeting sanitation and cleanability requirements. Chemical processors use mixers and agitators to
handle corrosive compounds, viscosity changes, and controlled dispersion. Pharmaceutical
manufacturers need repeatable batch performance, validation support, and material-compatible
construction. Water treatment facilities use agitators for suspension, conditioning, and chemical
distribution. Adhesive, sealant, and coatings operations depend on high shear and batch mixing
equipment that can manage solids loading, consistency, and uniform product finish across demanding
production cycles.

### Sizing and Production Volume Considerations

Start with production volume, batch size, and throughput requirements. A supplier that is right for
pilot runs or specialty batches may not be the best fit for continuous, high-volume manufacturing.
Buyers comparing industrial mixer manufacturers should confirm whether a supplier’s equipment is
built for short runs, frequent changeovers, or sustained production at scale.

### Matching Process Requirements to Equipment Type

Next, match the process to the equipment type. Some applications need gentle blending, while others
require high shear, aggressive dispersion, or tank agitation to keep materials suspended. This is
where terms like industrial mixers, industrial agitators, and industrial batch mixers matter,
because the right configuration depends on viscosity, solids content, shear sensitivity, and desired
end-product uniformity.

## [More Industrial Mixer Manufacturers][116]


### Industrial Mixer Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare industrial mixer manufacturers, mixer manufacturers, and specialized mixing
equipment suppliers serving chemical processing, food production, pharmaceuticals, water treatment,
coatings, adhesives, agriculture, and other demanding industries. This directory helps buyers browse
industrial mixers, mixers and agitators, batch systems, and related processing equipment by
application, material characteristics, and production goals. Whether you need to source an
industrial mixer for liquids, powders, slurries, or viscous compounds, this page is built to connect
engineers, purchasing teams, and plant managers with qualified suppliers that can match throughput,
consistency, sanitation, and process requirements across a wide range of manufacturing environments.

### Industrial Mixer Types and Core Functions

Industrial mixers support blending, dispersion, emulsification, and homogenization across many
production settings, making them a core category for buyers comparing equipment by viscosity, batch
size, and material behavior. Suppliers in this directory cover paddle, ribbon, planetary, static,
inline, and high shear designs used in chemical manufacturing, food processing, cosmetics, and
pharmaceutical production where repeatable mixing and controlled product quality matter.

### Industrial Agitators and Process Support Systems

Industrial agitators are often selected for lower-viscosity materials, tank circulation, suspension,
and process support in water treatment, storage, coating preparation, and liquid chemical handling.
Buyers searching industrial agitators, agitator manufacturer options, or complete mixers and
agitators can use this directory to compare suppliers that build equipment for maintaining
uniformity, supporting transfer operations, and improving consistency in continuous or
semi-continuous systems.

### Mixers and Agitators for Combined Process Needs

Industrial mixers and agitators are also specified together when facilities need broader process
flexibility across multiple products or stages of production. Buyers evaluating agitators and
mixers, agitators mixers, or mixer company capabilities often need suppliers that understand both
shear requirements and gentle blending, especially in operations involving adhesives, sealants,
pulp, slurry compounds, specialty chemicals, and prepared food ingredients.

### Industrial Batch Mixing Systems

Industrial batch mixers are especially relevant where formulations require timed cycles, ingredient
staging, recipe control, and lot traceability. These systems are common in pharmaceuticals,
nutraceuticals, dry blending, specialty coatings, and compound manufacturing, where plants need
precise repeatability and reliable discharge performance while balancing throughput with product
integrity.

### Industry Applications for Mixing Equipment

Food producers rely on industrial mixers for blending powders, liquids, syrups, and emulsions while
meeting sanitation and cleanability requirements. Chemical processors use mixers and agitators to
handle corrosive compounds, viscosity changes, and controlled dispersion. Pharmaceutical
manufacturers need repeatable batch performance, validation support, and material-compatible
construction. Water treatment facilities use agitators for suspension, conditioning, and chemical
distribution. Adhesive, sealant, and coatings operations depend on high shear and batch mixing
equipment that can manage solids loading, consistency, and uniform product finish across demanding
production cycles.

### Sizing and Production Volume Considerations

Start with production volume, batch size, and throughput requirements. A supplier that is right for
pilot runs or specialty batches may not be the best fit for continuous, high-volume manufacturing.
Buyers comparing industrial mixer manufacturers should confirm whether a supplier’s equipment is
built for short runs, frequent changeovers, or sustained production at scale.

### Matching Process Requirements to Equipment Type

Next, match the process to the equipment type. Some applications need gentle blending, while others
require high shear, aggressive dispersion, or tank agitation to keep materials suspended. This is
where terms like industrial mixers, industrial agitators, and industrial batch mixers matter,
because the right configuration depends on viscosity, solids content, shear sensitivity, and desired
end-product uniformity.

## Sinds 1916 uw partner in de keuken!

[Over ons][59]

Familiebedrijf Levo is al sinds 1916 dé partner voor horeca en industriële bedrijven. Met een
uitgebreid en compleet assortiment aan plantaardige oliën, frituuroliën, sauzen en margarines is
Levo al jarenlang vertegenwoordigd bij diverse horecabedrijven. U vindt ons bij restaurants,
cafetaria’s, snackbars, hotels, brasseries, strandpaviljoens, viswinkels, oliebollenbakkers, sport-
en bedrijfskantines en in de catering.

[Plantaardige olie][60]

### Plantaardige olie
* 100% plantaardig
* Gegarandeerd verse olie
* Diverse verpakkingsmogelijkheden

[Frituurolie][61]

### Frituurolie
* Extra krokant bakresultaat
* Zeer lange levensduur
* 100% plantaardig

[Sauzen][62]

### Sauzen
* Uitgebreid assortiment
* Gluten- en lactosevrij
* Exclusief voor de horeca

## Koken met Levo

De toepassingen met onze producten zijn eindeloos. Horecagelegenheden maken al jarenlang met veel
plezier gebruik van onze oliën, frituuroliën, sauzen en margarines. Maak ook kennis met Levo en
bekijk hoe onze klanten koken met Levo.

# Accueil


### Margarine Thibault, Situé à Trois-Rivières en Mauricie, est le seul fabricant québécois de
### margarine et tartinades.

### nous faisons des produits de qualité qui se démarquent depuis plus de 100 ans.

[IMG_4921.jpg]

## [Supermarché][50]

Bonne à tartiner, bonne à cuisiner, bonne pour la santé et surtout bonne au goût! Nos margarines
sont parfaites pour toutes vos recettes. 

Fabriquée sans OGM et végétalienne, notre Nuvel est le seul vrai choix pour un déjeuner santé.
Découvrez aussi nos margarines Bergeron et Thibault.

## [Hotels, Restos et institutions][51]

Nous savons que le travail en cuisine est aussi exigant qu'important. Notre vaste gamme de produits
santé — consciencieuse des intolérances et allergies — facilitera votre travail. Vous trouverez ici
un aperçu détaillé de nos produits.

[IMG_5351.jpg]

## [Boulangerie et pâtisserie][52]

Nous fabriquons bien plus que des margarines, tartinades et oléobeurres pour le commerce au détail;
nous sommes derrière un important nombre de produits de boulangerie-pâtisserie consommés chaque jour
par des milliers de québécois et de canadiens!

## [Sur mesure][53]

Mettez notre laboratoire et notre savoir-faire à votre service!

Margarine Thibault développe des tartinades et margarines sur mesure pour les marques privées du
commerce au détail et de l'hôtellerie. 

Des idées? Nous, on en a!

When my father, Gulamabbas Dewji, started the MeTL Group in the 1970s it was merely a small trading

affordable prices. Since I joined my father in the business in 1999, our company has grown in leaps
and bounds to become a major economic powerhouse in East Africa. And yet we remain insatiably
committed to that vision. We have developed new products, introduced new services, and invested in
new technology and knowledge while continuing to offer our buyers and consumers value for money.

# Supplier & Exporter of Oleochemicals, Palm Oil & Its Derivatives

Olivia Oleo is your one-stop premier source for quality oleochemicals, palm oil, and its
derivatives. We are a leading supplier and exporter based in Singapore, serving diverse industries
from soap to food and pharmaceuticals. The supply chain management at Olivia Oleo is known to be the
best across the industry and the transformational products provide perfect and customized solutions
to all manufacturers irrespective of the scale they operate in.

Olivia Oleo is focused on nurturing and sustainably strengthening the entire gamut of Palm oil and
derivatives, oleochemical supply most securely and responsibly. The endeavor has been to be the
one-stop solution for wide range oleochemicals including snow white soap noodles, swing soap
noodles/[multipurpose soap noodles][33], [laundry soap noodles][34], sodium palmitate, refined
glycerine 99.7% USP grade / 99.7% E422 food grade, palm fatty acid distillate (PFAD), palm kernel
fatty acid distillate (PKFAD), coconut fatty acid distillate (CFAD), [distilled coconut fatty
acid][35] (DCFA), distilled palm fatty acid (DPFA), distilled palm kernel fatty acid (DPKFA), RBD
palm stearine, RBD palm olein CP10, RBD Palm Olein CP8, RBD Palm Olein CP6, vegetable
shortening/vegetable fat, margarine, [hydrogenated palm kernel oil][36] (HPKO), RBD palm kernel oil,
triple pressed stearic acid (TPSA), RBD coconut oil, crude coconut oil, palmitic acid, oleic acid,
lauric acid, High FFA CPO, SLES 70%, Betaine/CAPB and many more for global clients spread across
Europe, Middle East, Africa, America and Asian countries that continuously be in expansion mode.

Our success lies in our management strategy which focuses on partnering with all clients in all
sectors and regions identifying their opportunities and addressing their most critical challenges.
All the clients get an unmatchable competitive advantage and the right insights. The international
quality checks are stringent and the processes are so well in control that a consistent quality is
delivered. The packing options are equally versatile and in conformance with global quality
standards.

Olivia Oleo has been synonymous with accomplishing volumes and quality based on modern technologies
and fulfilling customer satisfaction at its best oleochemicals. The network of our clients has been
on the increase across countries with integration beyond expectations. The experienced team works in
unison to deliver nothing but the best. We take on our client's challenges as our own bringing them
the right mix of science, engineering, and business opportunities.

## Our global sourcing locations

** Our products originate from Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and India. We maintain strong
collaborative relationships with leading oleochemical manufacturers and refiners, fostering trusted,
long-term partnerships and a steady supply of guaranteed high-quality products **

derivatives. We are a leading supplier and exporter based in Singapore, serving diverse industries

to all manufacturers irrespective of the scale they operate in.

one-stop solution for wide range oleochemicals including snow white soap noodles, swing soap

lauric acid, High FFA CPO, SLES 70%, Betaine/CAPB and many more for global clients spread across
Europe, Middle East, Africa, America and Asian countries that continuously be in expansion mode.

Our success lies in our management strategy which focuses on partnering with all clients in all
sectors and regions identifying their opportunities and addressing their most critical challenges.

quality checks are stringent and the processes are so well in control that a consistent quality is
delivered. The packing options are equally versatile and in conformance with global quality
standards.

Olivia Oleo has been synonymous with accomplishing volumes and quality based on modern technologies
and fulfilling customer satisfaction at its best oleochemicals. The network of our clients has been
on the increase across countries with integration beyond expectations. The experienced team works in
unison to deliver nothing but the best. We take on our client's challenges as our own bringing them
the right mix of science, engineering, and business opportunities.

> **Royale Lacroix** puise loin [dans son passé][18], son expérience du travail de la margarine et
> des matières grasses afin de proposer une gamme étendue de [produits pour la table, la
> cuisine][19], [les professionnels de l’industrie][20] dont la biscuiterie, la pâtisserie, la
> boulangerie artisanale et industrielle.
> 
> Au travers de notre expertise, nous proposons des solutions personnalisées à ces différents
> secteurs d’activité. L’adéquation permanente de son outil de production aux exigences spécifiques
> de ses clients, se traduit par une progression constante sur les différents marchés
> internationaux.
> 
> Plus que jamais, nous recherchons l’excellence par la sélection des matières premières, avec le
> souci de la [qualité totale][21] et du maintien d’une culture de la sécurité alimentaire. Dans
> cette optique de qualité, la direction a mis en place une politique visant à assurer la croissance
> et la pérennité de la société et à doter celle-ci d’un avantage concurrentiel durable.
> 
> N’hésitez pas à nous [contacter][22] pour toute question relative à vos produits, innovation, nous
> serions particulièrement honoré de contribuer à votre dynamique d’entreprise.
